# Notes

## Who it is for

People who jot short notes during the day and want to find one again in seconds. They are busy, often on a
phone, and they will not read instructions.

## The goal

A notes app that never loses what someone wrote and finds it again at once.

- G1 People can add a note. Done when a note added on the page shows at the top of the list.
- G2 People can find a note. Done when searching for a word lists only the notes that hold it.
- G3 The app says plainly when it cannot save. Done when a failed save shows one sentence and keeps the text.

## How it looks and feels

Quiet and fast: one column of notes, newest first, with the box to add one always at the top.

![The list of notes](goal/list.svg)

## How it speaks

Short, plain sentences. It says "note", never "item" or "entry", and it never blames the person.
